sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can talk about buses, trams and the metro, and say how I travel using -val/-vel.
I can buy a ticket or pass and ask how much it costs and how long it is valid.
I can ask when a bus or tram departs, arrives, or how often it runs.
I can talk about changing lines and ask which-numbered bus or tram to take.
I can ask how to get somewhere and give simple step-by-step directions.
